summary: SmartStop Self Storage REIT filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to declare a monthly dividend of $0.13589041 per share for July 2026, with a record date of July 31 and payment on August 14. This is a routine regular dividend declaration, reflecting a targeted annualized rate of $1.60 per share. No special situation—such as acquisition, divestiture, activism, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or abrupt management change—is present. The filing is a standard current report for ordinary dividend operations.
